StudentProfile.title: StudentProfile
StudentProfile.description: Represents a student's personal learning profile, including their settings, progress, and preferences.

id.description: Unique identifier for the StudentProfile entity.

name.description: The full name of the student.

className.description: The student's current academic class or grade level.

currentScore.description: The student's current overall score or performance metric.

targetScore.description: The student's desired target score or goal.

dailyAvailableStudyTimeMinutes.description: The amount of time (in minutes) the student can dedicate to studying daily.

preferredLanguage.description: The student's preferred interface and content language (e.g., 'Kazakh').

preferredFormat.description: The student's preferred content format (e.g., 'short' for concise, 'detailed' for in-depth explanations).

selectedSubjectIds.description: References to Subjects chosen by the student. (Relationship: StudentProfile N:N Subject)

weakSubjectIds.description: References to Subjects identified as weak areas for the student. (Relationship: StudentProfile N:N Subject)

strongSubjectIds.description: References to Subjects identified as strong areas for the student. (Relationship: StudentProfile N:N Subject)

weakTopicIds.description: References to Topics identified as weak areas for the student. (Relationship: StudentProfile N:N Topic)

strongTopicIds.description: References to Topics identified as strong areas for the student. (Relationship: StudentProfile N:N Topic)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the student profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the student profile was last updated.

Subject.title: Subject
Subject.description: Represents an academic subject offered in the platform, e.g., 'Математика', 'Физика'.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Subject entity.

description.description: A brief description of the subject.

iconUrl.description: URL for an icon representing the subject.

Topic.title: Topic
Topic.description: Represents a specific learning topic within a subject, containing theoretical content.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Topic entity.

subjectId.description: Reference to the Subject this topic belongs to. (Relationship: Subject 1:N Topic)

definition.description: The definition or main concept of the topic.

keyRule.description: The core rule or principle associated with the topic.

formulaOrDate.description: Relevant formula, date, or law related to the topic.

explanation.description: A detailed explanation of the topic.

simpleExample.description: A straightforward example illustrating the topic.

howItAppearsInUBT.description: Description of how this topic is typically presented or tested in ҰБТ exams.

commonMistakes.description: Common errors students make when dealing with this topic.

memoryHack.description: Tips or techniques to aid in memorizing or understanding the topic.

difficulty.description: The perceived difficulty level of the topic (e.g., 'оңай', 'орта', 'қиын').

order.description: The sequential order of the topic within its subject or section.

Question.title: Question
Question.description: Represents a single practice or test question.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Question entity.

subjectId.description: Reference to the Subject this question belongs to. (Relationship: Subject 1:N Question)

topicId.description: Reference to the Topic this question primarily tests. (Relationship: Topic 1:N Question)

text.description: The text content of the question.

options.description: An array of possible answer options for the question.

correctAnswerIndex.description: The zero-based index of the correct answer within the 'options' array.

explanation.description: A detailed explanation for the correct answer.

whyOtherAnswersWrong.description: Explanation of why the other answer options are incorrect.

commonMistakeWarning.description: A warning about common mistakes related to this question or topic.

difficulty.description: The difficulty level of the question (e.g., 'оңай', 'орта', 'қиын').

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the question was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the question was last updated.

TestSession.title: TestSession
TestSession.description: Records a student's attempt at a test, diagnostic, or quiz.

id.description: Unique identifier for the TestSession entity.

studentId.description: Reference to the StudentProfile who took the test. (Relationship: StudentProfile 1:N TestSession)

subjectId.description: Reference to the Subject, if the test is subject-specific. (Relationship: Subject 1:N TestSession)

topicIds.description: References to Topics covered in this test session. (Relationship: TestSession N:N Topic)

startTime.description: Timestamp when the test session started.

endTime.description: Timestamp when the test session ended.

durationMinutes.description: The total duration of the test session in minutes.

score.description: The raw score obtained by the student in this test session.

percentageScore.description: The percentage score obtained by the student.

totalQuestions.description: The total number of questions in the test session.

correctAnswersCount.description: The number of questions answered correctly.

incorrectAnswersCount.description: The number of questions answered incorrectly.

skippedQuestionsCount.description: The number of questions skipped by the student.

isCompleted.description: Indicates whether the test session was completed by the student.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the test session record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the test session record was last updated.

StudentQuestionAttempt.title: StudentQuestionAttempt
StudentQuestionAttempt.description: Details a student's attempt on a specific question within a test session.

id.description: Unique identifier for the StudentQuestionAttempt entity.

testSessionId.description: Reference to the TestSession this attempt belongs to. (Relationship: TestSession 1:N StudentQuestionAttempt)

questionId.description: Reference to the Question attempted. (Relationship: Question 1:N StudentQuestionAttempt)

studentAnswerIndex.description: The zero-based index of the option chosen by the student. Null if skipped.

isCorrect.description: Indicates whether the student's answer was correct.

timeTakenSeconds.description: The time taken by the student to answer this question in seconds.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the attempt was recorded.

MistakePattern.title: MistakePattern
MistakePattern.description: Defines common mistake patterns or frequently confused concepts for targeted analysis.

id.description: Unique identifier for the MistakePattern entity.

name.description: A short, descriptive name for the mistake pattern (e.g., 'arithmetic progression vs geometric progression').

description.description: A detailed description of what makes this a common mistake or confusion point.

comparisonContent.description: Content for a comparison card, explaining the nuances between confused items.

warningMessage.description: A warning message to alert students about this particular mistake (e.g., 'Осы жерде абай бол').

relatedTopicIds.description: References to Topics where this mistake pattern is commonly encountered. (Relationship: MistakePattern N:N Topic)

StudyPlan.title: StudyPlan
StudyPlan.description: Represents a generated daily or weekly study plan for a student.

id.description: Unique identifier for the StudyPlan entity.

studentId.description: Reference to the StudentProfile for whom the plan was generated. (Relationship: StudentProfile 1:N StudyPlan)

startDate.description: The start date of the study plan.

endDate.description: The end date of the study plan (relevant for weekly plans).

generatedByAI.description: Indicates if the study plan was generated by an AI.

targetScoreRange.description: The score range this study plan is tailored for (e.g., '50-70 балл').

isCompleted.description: Indicates if all items in the study plan have been completed.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the study plan was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the study plan was last updated.

StudyPlanItem.title: StudyPlanItem
StudyPlanItem.description: An individual task or activity within a StudyPlan.

id.description: Unique identifier for the StudyPlanItem entity.

studyPlanId.description: Reference to the StudyPlan this item belongs to. (Relationship: StudyPlan 1:N StudyPlanItem)

subjectId.description: Reference to the Subject involved in this plan item. (Relationship: Subject 1:N StudyPlanItem)

topicId.description: Reference to the Topic involved in this plan item. (Relationship: Topic 1:N StudyPlanItem)

durationMinutes.description: The planned duration for this item in minutes (primarily for daily plans).

description.description: A description of the plan item (e.g., '30 min theory', 'жаңа тақырып').

dayOfWeek.description: The day of the week for this plan item (e.g., 'Дүйсенбі' for weekly plans).

isCompleted.description: Indicates whether the student has completed this plan item.

completedAt.description: Timestamp when this plan item was marked as completed.

order.description: The sequential order of this item within its study plan.

ProgressEntry.title: ProgressEntry
ProgressEntry.description: Logs a student's daily study activity and performance metrics.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ProgressEntry entity.

studentId.description: Reference to the StudentProfile associated with this progress entry. (Relationship: StudentProfile 1:N ProgressEntry)

date.description: The date for which this progress entry is recorded.

subjectId.description: Reference to the Subject, if the progress is specific to one subject. (Relationship: Subject 1:N ProgressEntry)

topicId.description: Reference to the Topic, if the progress is specific to one topic. (Relationship: Topic 1:N ProgressEntry)

lessonsCompletedCount.description: The number of theory lessons or topics completed on this day.

questionsSolvedCount.description: The total number of questions solved on this day.

mistakesCount.description: The total number of mistakes made on this day.

studyTimeMinutes.description: The total time spent studying on this day in minutes.

notes.description: Any additional notes or remarks for this progress entry (e.g., 'ескерту').

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this progress entry was created.

CuratorInteraction.title: CuratorInteraction
CuratorInteraction.description: Records interactions between a student and the AI curator, including messages and motivational content.

id.description: Unique identifier for the CuratorInteraction entity.

studentId.description: Reference to the StudentProfile involved in the interaction. (Relationship: StudentProfile 1:N CuratorInteraction)

content.description: The text content of the message or a reference/ID to a motivation card template.

suggestedRepliesUsed.description: An array of suggested replies that were presented to the student (if applicable).

sentiment.description: Analyzed sentiment of the student's message (e.g., 'positive', 'neutral', 'negative').

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore data structure is designed to adhere strictly to the core design principles and mandates, prioritizing security, scalability, and debuggability. All user-specific data is organized under a top-level `/studentProfiles/{studentId}` collection, ensuring strong ownership and clear access patterns. Global, static content such as Subjects, Topics, Questions, and Mistake Patterns are stored in separate top-level collections or logical subcollections. This structural segregation ensures that documents with different security postures are not mixed, simplifying security rules.

**Authorization Independence via Denormalization:** This is a critical aspect of the design. For all user-owned subcollections (e.g., `testSessions`, `studyPlans`, `questionAttempts`, `studyPlanItems`, `progressEntries`, `curatorInteractions`), the `studentId` (which corresponds to `request.auth.uid`) is explicitly denormalized and included within each document of the subcollection. For example, a `StudentQuestionAttempt` document will contain `studentId` in addition to its parent `testSessionId`. This eliminates the need for expensive and complex `get()` calls in security rules to check parent document ownership, enabling atomic operations and making rules robust and easy to debug. The path itself also contains the `{studentId}` wildcard, providing a primary layer of authorization.

**Support for QAPs (Rules are not Filters):**
1.  **Public Content (Subjects, Topics, Questions, Mistake Patterns):** These collections are designed for broad read access by all authenticated students. Since all documents within these collections share the same 'read-only for all' security posture, `list` operations are inherently secure and efficient. Rules will simply allow `read` for `request.auth != null`.
2.  **Private User-Owned Content (StudentProfile and its subcollections):** The structure `/studentProfiles/{studentId}/...` directly ties data to the authenticated user's UID. For `list` operations on collections like `/studentProfiles/{studentId}/testSessions`, the `studentId` wildcard in the path *must* match `request.auth.uid`. Additionally, the denormalized `studentId` field within each document provides an explicit check (e.g., `resource.data.studentId == request.auth.uid`), which ensures that even if a query attempts to list data for a different student (which would be blocked by the path matching), individual document access is also secured. This layered approach ensures `list` queries are only successful when the path matches the authenticated user, thus preventing rules from acting as filters and promoting secure, performant access.

Global roles for administrative access, while not explicitly mapped to an entity schema, would be handled via an existence-based collection like `/roles_admin/{uid}`, further simplifying rule logic for content management.
